blocks.text: Why should take this bag? You can take this MOSISO Waterproof PU leather laptop tote bag with clutch purse & bowknot & shoulder strap to hold your laptop and work daily life.

items.label: Internal Dimensions
items.value: 15.35 x 5.12 x 11.81 inch (L x W x H); External dimensions: 17.32 x 5.12 x 12.59 inch (L x W x H). The vertical height of double handle: 7.87 inch. The front zipper pocket dimensions: 12.99 x 7.48 inches (L x W).

items: Compatible with 15-15.6 inch Laptop. Roomy enough with 3 compartments for all daily stuff. The computer compartment in the middle provides a thick padded foam section for your laptop or tablet. Exterior magnetic buckle pockets offer quick access to items. Professional design to protect your laptop against accidental impacts and scratches.

Large Capacity Multiple Compartments. Holds your laptop, tablet and everything you need. Two side pockets keep to store your water bottle when you go out or work. Enough room design keeps your all items well organized. Whether you are working, traveling, or daily use, It is an ideal bag for women on the go.

Made of Waterproof PU Leather Material. Reinforced bottom with 4 rivets protects your objects from damage and keep the tote bag at attractive and stylish status. Elegant and Considerate Design. The women tote bag complements a wide range of styles. It is professionally for special occasions, such as anniversary or birthday. Suitable for working, shopping,traveling and daily use.

Compatible with MacBook Air 15 inch M4 A3241 M3 A3114 M2 A2941 2025 2024 2023, compatible with MacBook Pro 16 2025-2019 M4 A3403 A3186 M3 A2991 M2 A2780 M1 A2485 A2141, compatible with MacBook Pro 15 A1990 A1707 A1398; Compatible with Surface Laptop 5/4/3 15, compatible with Surface Book 3/2/1 15; Compatible with Asus ZenBook/VivoBook 15; Compatible with Acer Swift 3/Swift 5/Aspire 3/5/7 15.6; Compatible with HP ProBook/Spectre x360/Envy x360 15.6; compatible with HP Omen/Pavilion x360 15.6.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Avoid excessive heat, direct sunlight, and sharp objects. Clean with a damp cloth.
